name: unchecked-is-not-proven
why: The rule the line turns on. Both targets carry the proven release, and the difference is whether anything looked. `watched` declares a probe that could not be read, so it is unreadable: reporting it current would claim what nothing saw. `closes-at-deployed` declares no acceptance at all, so carrying the release IS the whole promotion and it is current. A surface that treats a missing answer as a passing one is the anti-pattern this case exists to catch.

positions.name: watched
positions.detail: serves v2.1.0, and its declared probe could not be read
